location_note: Southern slope of the Mount of Olives below the old Jerusalem-Jericho road; map ref. NIG 22365/63108, OIG 17365/13108 (Kloner 2001, Site 439).
notes: Burial complex: quarried courtyard with bench, passage, antechamber with shaft, kokhim chamber (examined, not excavated), repository, unexcavated lower room; inscribed ossuary 'Ishmael'; looted in antiquity. Medieval-modern charcoal drawings on the antechamber ceiling.

features.subtype: rock-hewn burial complex: courtyard, antechamber with shaft, burial chamber with six kokhim and lamp niches, repository; ossuary burial
features.period: original use in the 1st c. CE (Second Temple period)
features.quote: original period of use of the cave during the first century CE
